147:t_1:178.en:
$$千葉$$
「We have a report of an enemy attack...!」

147:t_1:179.en:
$$玉城$$
「Damn it! They're hitting Tokyo at a time like this!」

147:t_1:181.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「I know. They're most likely moving in response to someone with the power to amplify hatred.」

147:t_1:183.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「The enemy is going to launch an all-out attack...! Concentrate the forces of every front in Tokyo!」

147:t_1:184.en:
$$藤堂$$
「If we don't win this battle, $$新日本$$ has no future...! We'll give it everything we have and meet the enemy head-on!」

147:t_1:186.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「...I am $$ゼロ$$... The man who works miracles.」

147:t_1:187.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「And I'll make them pay...! The price for forcing me to use $$ギアス$$ again!」

147:t_2:7.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Give yourself over to the hatred, $n. Then it will all get easier.」

147:t_2:9.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Hold on, $n...! Inside you, hatred and the feelings that oppose it are fighting right now!」

147:t_2:10.en:
$$スズネ$$
「If you overcome the hatred, you will...!」

147:t_2:13.en:
$$スズネ$$
「No, I won't be quiet. I have a right to speak up too.」

147:t_2:14.en:
$n
「Mo...m...! No, Mom! I... I don't want to die!」

147:t_2:19.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Is this... $n's heart and Miss $$スズネ$$'s heart mixing together...?」

147:t_3:5.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「We were beaten at the very last moment. To think they had the resolve to destroy their own city with their own hands...」

147:t_3:6.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「I'd figured either way worked: $$ゼロ$$ going down fighting to answer the citizens' hopes, or admitting defeat and fleeing as his authority crumbles. But this result surprises me.」

147:t_3:8.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「With the wounds of the past they carry, I'd thought defending the city would be their greatest tactical objective...」

147:t_3:9.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「No, no... As expected, the Earthling mind is unique even by galactic standards.」

147:t_3:11.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「What do you intend to do about $$新日本$$?」

147:t_3:12.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Leave it to $$ギルター$$ or someone.」

147:t_3:13.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Hmm... With today's dramatic finale, the Japanese have had their morale lifted again, you see. I'm afraid $$ギルター$$ would have a hard time of it...」

147:t_3:15.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「...Understood. Well, $$新日本$$ has all but fallen anyway, so even if it takes a little time from here on, it won't be a problem.」

147:t_3:17.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Rest assured on that front. As arranged, I've sent out a pursuit force.」

147:t_3:18.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Poor things, with their broken hearts. Pursuers are coming after them without a moment's rest.」

147:t_3:19.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「If that's enough to crush them, then that's all they were. $c, and that man called $n as well.」

147:t_3:20.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Well then, shall we head home? To the imperial capital, $$ラース・バビロン$$.」

147:t_3:21.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「'Remember this,' huh... Heh... Cheap words.」

147:t_3:22.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「$c, $n... Don't think you can beat me with such shallow hatred.」

147:t_3:27.en:
$$アムロ$$
「...I see. So that's why $$チェーン$$ went down to Earth: to receive the $$νガンダム$$, whose whereabouts were unknown.」

147:t_3:28.en:
$$チェーン$$
「But the Federation troops at that base were already in league with the $$サイデリアル$$, and they had captured me.」

147:t_3:29.en:
$$アムロ$$
「They didn't treat you roughly, did they?」

147:t_3:30.en:
$$チェーン$$
「No, I'm fine. It seems they just wanted me to maintain the $$νガンダム$$.」

147:t_3:32.en:
$$チェーン$$
「...I don't know. They may have meant to use it as part of their own forces, but I don't think there are many pilots who could handle it.」

147:t_3:33.en:
$$チェーン$$
「From some information I overheard, they said something about sending it to $$オーガスタ研究所$$...」

147:t_3:34.en:
$$アムロ$$
「A $$ニュータイプ$$ research lab, huh... They may have been planning to use the $$νガンダム$$ for new enhanced humans...」

147:t_3:35.en:
$$チェーン$$
「After that, $$ソレスタルビーイング$$ rescued me, and I've been aboard the $$プトレマイオス$$ ever since.」

147:t_3:36.en:
$$チェーン$$
「And I took part in the $$セントラル・ベース$$ capture operation too, but...」

147:t_3:37.en:
$$アムロ$$
「That man... Was it $$バルビエル$$ who took you down...?」

147:t_3:39.en:
$$アムロ$$
「That man's power may exceed even that of $$ガドライト#pilot$$, whom we fought in the $$時獄戦役$$...」

147:t_3:40.en:
$$アムロ$$
「In a situation where they couldn't even resupply, even $$ソレスタルビーイング$$ would have had a hard time facing him.」

147:t_3:42.en:
$$タクヤ$$
「Captain $$アムロ$$! They say a $$サイデリアル$$ unit is closing in on us!」

147:t_3:43.en:
$$ミコット$$
「All mobile unit members have been ordered to prepare to sortie!」

147:t_3:46.en:
$$アムロ$$
「If they're making us their target, so much the better. I'll keep moving and throw them into confusion.」

147:t_3:48.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Either way, a fight with that man $$バルビエル$$ can't be avoided. He seems to be targeting $n.」

147:t_3:49.en:
$$アムロ$$
(But what was that I felt inside $n's heart back then...? What was it...?)

147:t_3:50.en:
$$アムロ$$
(That dark emotion... Is something like that sleeping inside $n...?)

147:t_3:51.en:
$$アムロ$$
(And then there's Miss $$スズネ$$... Just what is she...?)

147:t_10:4.en:
$n
「Sorry, $$ＡＧ$$. The $$サイデリアル$$ are here. Save the talk for later.」

147:t_10:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...The $$怨嗟の魔蠍$$, $$バルビエル・ザ・ニードル$$... It seems the appearance of a new Reactor is bothering you.」

147:t_10:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「But it seems the same goes for that $$バルビエル$$. That man... showed considerable interest in the $$スフィア$$ of the $$いがみ合う双子$$.」

147:t_10:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The $$Ｚチップ$$ worth 50 Z born when $n fought that man... I'll add them to the unit's stock.」
